posts.en:
dsh-free-search is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Free, keyless web search for DSH: 7 engines (DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG free + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), auto-failover, settings-page UI with API key inputs and official links, web_fetch, and an engine test tool.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e3765167a98cced6ca4b.html
